Machine Learning Engineer at HealthInsight Analytics, leveraging 4+ years in healthtech to build scalable solutions. Specialize in NLP systems that streamline clinical workflows, reducing manual data entry by 30% in two hospital partnerships. Developed PyTorch-based predictive models for chronic disease risk assessment, now used across 12+ clinics. TensorFlow expertise drives personalized treatment recommendations, enhancing patient outcomes in real-time.  
AWS powers our data pipelines, handling 500M+ records monthly. Docker and Kubernetes ensure seamless model deployment, with 99.9% uptime for critical care tools. Advocating for ethical AI, I lead audits to mitigate bias in diagnostic algorithms.  
Collaborate with clinicians to turn complex health data into actionable insights. Always seeking to merge technical rigor with human-centric design in healthcare innovation.
